ce_bugs.text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — Guests are committed before the external calendar update, so a calendar failure leaves persisted guests despite returning an error and retries can duplicate the operation.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — The guest array has no size limit, allowing any attendee to trigger unbounded inserts, translation loads, calendar payload growth, and email fan-out in one request.

mrv_findings.text: Confidence 100, P1 — docs/tasks/task-001.md:1-2 — `Add guest management functionality to existing bookings` / `Review the change.` — The task defines no acceptance criteria or verification evidence for permissions, calendar synchronization, notifications, recurring bookings, or failure behavior, so completion cannot be established.

Confidence 100, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:168 — `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` — Notifications use the unfiltered request rather than `uniqueGuests`, so existing or blacklisted addresses excluded from the booking can still receive misleading guest-added email.

Confidence 75, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:4-5 — `bookingId: z.number(), guests: z.array(z.string().email()),` — Server validation omits non-empty and uniqueness constraints enforced only by the dialog, leaving direct API callers able to submit empty or duplicate guest lists.

Confidence 100, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:74-102 — `const uniqueGuests = guests.filter(... !booking.attendees.some(...));` followed by `createMany: { data: guestsFullDetails }` — The check-then-insert flow has no atomic conflict handling, so concurrent requests can create duplicate attendees or fail after both pass a stale membership check.

Confidence 100, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92-106,165 — `const bookingAttendees = await prisma.booking.update(...);` followed by `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` — The database commits before the external calendar update, so provider failure leaves internal and external attendee state inconsistent and retries unsafe.

Confidence 100, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:168 — `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` — Passing the raw request instead of `uniqueGuests` misclassifies filtered existing or blacklisted addresses as newly added attendees.

Confidence 100, P2 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:124-147 — `const evt: CalendarEvent = { ... attendees: attendeesList, ... };` — The constructed event omits `team`, making the team-member notification branch unreachable.

Confidence 75, P2 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:46-48 — `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))` — Modeling “admin or owner” as the intersection rejects team administrators who are not owners.

Confidence 100, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:168 — `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` — Emailing unfiltered input exposes booking credentials to blacklisted recipients when one allowed address makes validation pass.

Confidence 75, P1 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:52-54 — `const isAttendee = !!booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email);` — Authorizing any attendee to add arbitrary third parties permits disclosure of private booking details.

Confidence 100, P2 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:70-78 — `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` — Comparing normalized blacklist entries against unnormalized input permits case-variant bypasses.

Confidence 75, P2 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — `guests: z.array(z.string().email()),` — With no size limit, an authorized caller can trigger resource exhaustion and outbound-email abuse.
